decisive_items: compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery
response.rationale: R1 directly identifies the underlying compressive anatomy (May-Thurner syndrome) that explains the DVT, while R4 only states the thrombotic event itself. The CT finding is pathognomonic and more specific for the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R4 adding anatomical detail without new raw evidence; it does not improve diagnostic specificity and is redundant.
